case_title: VANCE WU VS. GERALD WAYNE LUM

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,175.93 FILED BY WU, VANCE AS TO DEFENDANT LUM, GERALD WAYNE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-25-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF WU, VANCE ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-25-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-07-2021 AT 5:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF VANCE WU IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GERALD WAYNE LUM IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1100 WAS GIVEN TO THE PLAINTIFF IN COURT: $1000 IN CASH AND $100 BY CHECK TO BE CASHED ON MAY-29TH . APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JUN-7TH HEARING IF PAYMENT IS NOT COMPLETED. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. SETTLED. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF VANCE WU. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT GERALD WAYNE LUM. MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)
